news.title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian agency IT systems
news.summary: The restrictions extend earlier bans within US defense and security agencies, amid concerns that DeepSeek could expose federal information to China.

news.title: Blockchain Association says Treasury’s GENIUS Act rollout needs clearer DeFi, foreign issuer rules
news.summary: The group filed comments on Treasury's proposed rule implementing the GENIUS Act, which governs who can issue and sell payment stablecoins.

news.title: Bitcoin rally could revive treasury buying, but easy-money days over
news.summary: “A return to last year’s indiscriminate capital raising looks unlikely,” said Bitfinex head of derivatives Jag Kooner.

news.title: BlackRock files for bitcoin ETF offering downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT
news.summary: One of the world's largest investment managers, BlackRock has filed for another bitcoin fund, marking its third tied to the asset.

news.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
news.summary: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

news.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
news.summary: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.

news.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
news.summary: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

news.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
news.summary: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.

news.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
news.summary: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

news.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
news.summary: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

news.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
news.summary: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

news.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
news.summary: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

news.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
news.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.

news.title: Mesh taps Visa to let users spend crypto without a separate card
news.summary: Mesh and Visa will let users spend crypto and stablecoin balances from wallet apps, with no need to sell or transfer assets first.

news.title: Bitcoin is rejected at $83K as US bond yields reverse higher with equities
news.summary: Bitcoin price action failed to improve with equities as a sell wall at $83,000 kept BTC in a tight range.

news.title: Mastercard unveils Stablecoin Security tool to screen payments for fraud and sanctions risks
news.summary: Mastercard unveiled Stablecoin Security, a risk screening service launching in North America before planned global availability in 2027.

news.title: Galaxy’s AI data center business is undervalued amid CoreWeave debt concerns, StoneX says
news.summary: StoneX reiterates Buy and $57 target on GLXY, saying the market undervalues its Helios AI data center despite CoreWeave debt worries.

news.title: SkyAI sells off entire Solana treasury as it launches $201 million buyback
news.summary: SkyAI holds $223.8 million in cash after selling all its SOL, with its $3 buyback running through Oct. 29.

news.title: AnchorWatch Trust Company launches bitcoin custody service with up to $370 million in insurance per client
news.summary: AnchorWatch launched Nevada-chartered bitcoin custody with a $10,000 monthly fee cap and optional insurance of up to $370 million per client.

news.title: Zerohash rolls out a new tool to move crypto without copying wallet addresses
news.summary: The launch comes as Zerohash bids for a federal trust charter.

news.title: Strive scoops up another 1,223 bitcoin for $100 million as total holdings reach 36,818 BTC
news.summary: Strive paid approximately $81,734 on average per bitcoin, adding to the 2,822 BTC it had acquired earlier last week.

news.title: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH as treasury reaches 6.04 million tokens
news.summary: Bitmine bought 12,535 ETH last week, lifting its treasury to 6.04 million tokens and total investment holdings to $15.1 billion.

news.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
news.summary: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.

news.title: Public companies object to OKX-ICE’s tokenized stock plan
news.summary: Nine public companies objected to having their shares offered in tokenized form by OKX and ICE, testing whether platforms can create blockchain-based markets without issuer consent.

news.title: Strategy buys $22M in Bitcoin, repurchases $193M in STRC
news.summary: Strategy added 267 Bitcoin to its holdings as it bought back 1.94 million STRC shares and boosted its preferred stock buyback program to $3 billion.

news.title: Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson is building a new programming language for the network
news.summary: Hoskinson said on X the language will bundle transaction requests with cryptographic proofs. He hasn’t shared a name, specs or a release date.

news.title: ‘We found room for more orange’: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys another 267 bitcoin for $22 million
news.summary: Strategy's BTC holdings account for around 4% of the total bitcoin supply, with $5.9 billion in paper gains.

news.title: World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin sheds $400M in market cap in two weeks
news.summary: World Liberty Financial’s USD1 stablecoin saw its market cap decrease more than $400 million over two weeks of large redemptions on Ethereum and BNB Chain.

news.title: BingX, YouHodler added to ESMA MiCA register in latest update
news.summary: ESMA’s latest MiCA register update includes BingX, YouHodler and Banco Santander’s Openbank, bringing the total to 375 unique CASPs.

news.title: Strategy's price chart is about to flash a major bullish signal weeks after bitcoin did
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 19, 2026

news.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $82,000 as Nasdaq rebounds more than 1%
news.summary: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount.

news.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto licence to support international expansion plans
news.summary: Revolut secured a Gibraltar DLT licence for a new entity to support its international crypto expansion strategy.

news.title: Bitcoin extends bounce above $82,000 as stocks rebound, DeFi tokens lead altcoin gains
news.summary: Bitcoin rose 0.8% to around $82,700 as China’s GDP beat estimates and Nasdaq futures rebounded, while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.3% and DeFi led gains.

news.title: France advances stablecoin tax, eyes self-custodial wallets and exit tax proposals
news.summary: France’s National Assembly adopted a crypto tax amendment targeting certain stablecoin swaps, while separate proposals on exit taxes and self-custodial wallet reporting remain under consideration.

news.title: Stocks rebound into key tech earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
news.summary: Analysts expect Bitcoin to retest $80,000 support again as stock markets attempt to recover last week’s losses.

news.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin, representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum
news.summary: JPMorgan's dollar deposit token is heading to Ethereum as the lender looks to offer it to wider selection of institutional clients.

news.title: Crypto vault deposits top $10 billion as lending risks draw regulatory scrutiny
news.summary: Curator-managed lending strategies are attracting institutional capital, while exposing depositors to collateral, liquidity and smart-contract risks.

news.title: Bitcoin mining offshoot Nscale loses Microsoft AI deal as power delay stretches into 2030s
news.summary: The Nvidia-backed company planned to deliver 23,000 AI chips in the U.K. next year, but its grid connection may not be ready until the 2030s.

news.title: CME’s bitcoin cash, uniswap futures, global PMIs: Crypto Week Ahead
news.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 19.

news.title: JPMorgan takes JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients: Report
news.summary: JPMorgan is reportedly expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to make payments and settle tokenized asset transactions.

news.title: JPMorgan expands ‘JPM Coin’ deposit token to Ethereum for institutional clients
news.summary: The USD-denominated deposit token now supports peer-to-peer transfers within the Ethereum Virtual Machine ecosystem, including Base.

news.title: Bitcoin, Ether ETFs shed $549M as October ETH outflows near $1B
news.summary: US spot Ether ETFs recorded around $955 million in October net outflows so far, while Bitcoin funds extended their weekly withdrawal streak to two weeks.

news.title: Bitcoin whale moves $34 million in BTC it got in 2013 when coins traded at $131
news.summary: A bitcoin wallet dormant since 2013 moved 411 BTC, now worth about $34 million. It is one of several long-dormant wallets to wake up recently.

news.title: Zoom adds ‘proof of human’ badges to show you’re not a deepfake
news.summary: Sam Altman-backed World has rolled out biometric verification badges for Zoom enterprise users, aiming to combat AI deepfake impersonation and fraud.

news.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
news.summary: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

news.title: South Korea to meet crypto exchanges amid calls for tax delay
news.summary: Finance officials are reportedly set to meet major crypto exchanges on Tuesday, days after a lawmaker introduced legislation that could push the tax’s start date back two years.

news.title: XRP Ledger is set to fix its lending code before anyone can use it
news.summary: Validators have a bug-fix patch on course to go live Friday. The lending system it partly repairs is still 10 votes short of approval.

news.title: Bitcoin, Korea’s Kospi and Nasdaq futures rally as China GDP beats estimates
news.summary: Bitcoin, Nasdaq futures and Asian stocks rally as stronger-than-expected China GDP and falling oil prices lift risk appetite.

news.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
news.summary: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

news.title: World launches World ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available
news.summary: World ID for Zoom is generally available after a beta that began in April, and is designed to spot deepfaked participants on Zoom calls.

news.title: Qubic freezes chain after attacker drains 1.4K wallets with weak seeds
news.summary: Qubic says 87.1% of the stolen funds remain onchain and the rest were frozen at crypto exchange MEXC, as network validators prepare to vote on a recovery plan.

news.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
news.summary: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

news.title: Richard Heart caught ‘off-guard,’ QDay gets even closer: Hodler’s Digest
news.summary: HEX founder Richard Heart detained in early morning raid in Istanbul, Starknet plunges almost 50% as it votes to become an L1, and Bitwise says all signs point to Crypto Spring.

news.title: Crypto.com, Novig sue Missouri over sports event contracts; Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood hold off
news.summary: Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood and Underdog, which also received cease-and-desist orders, have not filed suits in Missouri, according to court records.

news.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
news.summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

news.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
news.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

news.title: Cysic suspends bridge after attacker mints tokens and moves $727,000 to Ethereum
news.summary: The attacker, after minting 10 million CYS, managed to bridge about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum through Mayan, deBridge and SWFT's Bridgers.

news.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
news.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

news.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
news.summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

news.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
news.summary: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

news.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
news.summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

news.title: Crypto exchanges Binance, Coinbase join West Africa scam sweep that flagged $11 million
news.summary: Private-sector partners flagged $11 million in funds that could be frozen, while officials reported cryptocurrency seizures without disclosing their value.

news.title: Chip-stock bets lost $52 million in 10 minutes with Wall Street shut
news.summary: A 10-minute flush hit round-the-clock chip-stock contracts while U.S. markets were shut, leaving traders with no real share price to lean on.

news.title: CoreWeave, Broadcom, Verizon among nine companies objecting to tokenized trading of their shares on OKXICE
news.summary: Applied Optoelectronics told the WSJ it objected because it was unsure how tokenization would affect its stock price, liquidity and volatility.

news.title: Turkey confirms Hex founder Richard Heart’s arrest, says police seized $7.15 million and six cold wallets
news.summary: Police reportedly seized $7.15 million in cash, six cold wallets, seven firearms and 1,400 rounds of ammunition in searches of 15 addresses.

news.title: Strive’s bitcoin buying spree earns 27% price target hike from TD Cowen
news.summary: Strive plans fresh funding for bitcoin purchases as TD Cowen sees warrant-related stock pressure easing.

news.title: Coinbase to power stablecoin-backed cards for Marqeta customers
news.summary: The expanded partnership builds on Marqeta’s work powering Coinbase’s U.S. debit card offering in 2020.

news.title: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026
news.summary: Circle breaks down its USDC revenue: about $1.4 billion in H1 2026, $819 million to partners and transaction costs, $473 million reinvested.
